the CC overhead lines are more prone to PDs due to falling/leaning trees and the Rogowski coils are more efficient than conventional sensors for the PD detection on the CC overhead distribution networks.

the development of an intelligent system for on-line condition assessment and fault localization of CC overhead distribution networks.
the detection of falling trees on CC overhead lines by using Rogowski coil.
the development of an innovative, non-intrusive PD sensor for on-line condition assessment of CC overhead lines.
